newsitem.title: UK: BBC Worldwide Int'l TV sales up 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: BBC Worldwide Int'l TV sales up 20 pct.

text.p: BBC Worldwide Ltd, the commercial arm of the British Broadcasting Corp, on Sunday said that annual programme sales and distribution business rose 20 percent.
It said in a statement that programme sales figures rose to 112.1 million stg for the year ending March 31, 1997.

Included in the list of the year's best-selling BBC programmes was the The People's Century, rock and roll history Dancing in the Street, costume drama Pride and Prejudice and the entertainment programme Ruby Wax meets the Duchess of York.

"The growth in our sales and distribution operation reflects the BBC's continuing commitment to quality and diversity," said Bob Phillis, the chief executive of BBC Worldwide and deputy director general of the BBC.
